method: Ten verified or editorially reviewable factors, each scored from 0 to 10. Totals are heuristic opportunity scores, not YouTube demand or revenue forecasts. No first-party engagement metric was available for Y1.

candidates.evidence: Owned racing game; immediate steering action, bright track contrast and a clear short-run loop.
Owned skill game; one-tap drops are legible immediately and naturally create near-miss moments.
Owned racing-action game; jumps, crates and ramps read clearly in a vertical capture.
Owned skill game; continuous pointer action and particle feedback create concise visual sequences.
Owned arcade game; recognisable motion and high-contrast presentation with a repeatable run.
Owned strategy game; visible junction decisions and collision tension suit short challenge edits.
Owned shooter; auto-fire, movement and targets are visually understandable without narration.
Owned puzzle game; matching feedback is colourful and suitable for satisfying short edits.
Owned action game; one-tap leaps and hazards provide an honest challenge structure.
Owned arcade game; aiming, coin hits and particles support distinct skill clips.
Owned puzzle game; clear matching interactions and bursts remain readable on mobile.
Owned arcade game; familiar paddle action and brick clears offer visible progression.
Owned puzzle game; real tile reveals and matches provide a calmer contrasting concept.
Owned sports game; aiming and goal attempts create an understandable payoff.
Owned action game; hold-and-release flight creates immediate movement and near misses.
Owned arcade game; collection and avoidance actions are suitable for short runs.
Owned action game; lane changes and hazards are clear, subject to content-suitability review per clip.
Owned arcade game; pinball motion and bumper effects are visually strong but less controllable for capture.
Owned puzzle game; grid navigation is legible but requires more context than the leading candidates.
Owned sports game; genuine shot attempts offer payoff, with more setup time than leading clips.
